text: Oh let those who [reverently] fear the LORD, say, "His lovingkindness endures forever."
It is better to take refuge in the LORD Than to trust in princes.
The LORD is my strength and song, And He has become my salvation.
The LORD has disciplined me severely, But He has not given me over to death.
I will give thanks to You, for You have heard and answered me; And You have become my salvation [my Rescuer, my Savior].
O give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; For His lovingkindness endures forever.
